assets.label: 麦田风车
assets.primaryRequest: a compact low medieval wheat windmill building, one plain square pale-fieldstone and dark-oak mill house, one simple muted golden-brown hipped roof, one centered wooden hub on the front face and exactly four broad wooden lattice sails forming one connected diagonal cross, restrained grain-store details; the building body ends at the ground-contact line
assets.structureRequest: exactly one low closed square 2x2 mill house and exactly one simple continuous hipped roof entirely contained inside the supplied control silhouette; no upper tower, no roof tower, no dormer, no cupola and no raised central block; exactly one centered front hub with exactly four broad wooden lattice windmill sails connected directly to it as two diagonal crossing beams; the sails are open lattice sails, not roof panels; solid lower walls continue directly to the ground-contact line; absolutely no base slab, plinth, platform, foundation, field or detached component
assets.detailRequest: preserve the exact low square mill house, single simple hipped roof, centered hub, camera, ground-contact edge and exactly four attached open-lattice sails; no upper tower, dormer, cupola, raised roof block, base slab, plinth or platform; refine pale fieldstone masonry, dark weathered oak framing, muted golden-brown shingles, crisp wooden sail latticework, one small closed grain door and warm shallow windows; no loose wheat, sacks or exterior props
